services.name: dram-bw
services.dockerfile:
FROM scratch
COPY dram-bwd /usr/local/bin/dram-bwd
WORKDIR /run/dram-bw
LABEL project-alpha.dram-settings="1"
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/dram-bwd","--settings","/run/dram-bw/service-settings"]

services.name: rootless-docker
services.dockerfile:
FROM scratch
COPY rootless-docker /rootless-docker
ENTRYPOINT ["/rootless-docker"]
CMD ["daemon","--host-namespaces"]
